title: Avocado RPM manifest, version 1
description: The RPMs a build produced, each with the digest of its header, written next to the CVE report. A correlation service joins it to the report on the package name and to a repository on the header digest. The shape is frozen, the contents are not: nothing here constrains which packages appear. Unknown keys are permitted - additions do not bump the major. See meta-avocado-sbom/README.

version.description: A consumer must reject a major it does not implement rather than read the parts it recognises.

distro_version.description: DISTRO_VERSION of the build, the same string the CVE report of the same build carries.

packages.description: One entry per RPM the build produced, sorted by name, arch, version and release. A second multiconfig's kernel is a second version of the same name. Never empty.

name.description: Binary package name, the key of the CVE report's packages map.

epoch.description: RPM epoch, null when the package has none. Zero is an epoch and is not the same as absent.

sha256header.description: sha256 of the main header section, the value rpm records as SHA256HEADER. Not a digest of the whole file, which also covers the payload.

file.description: Path of the RPM relative to the build's rpm deploy directory, <arch>/<name>-<version>-<release>.<arch>.rpm.
